item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00080","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C07","C06","C24"],"selected_candidate_label":"C07","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C07 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both are annual commemorative proclamations grounded in a congressional joint resolution, followed by the same two-part operative machinery: directing display of the United States flag on all Government buildings on the designated day and calling on the public to observe the day with specially designed ceremonies. The close wording and parallel sequence exceed generic proclamation boilerplate. C06 and C24 contain related flag-display and public-observance language but are less textually and structurally close.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I direct the appropriate officials to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all Government buildings on that day.","parent_excerpt":"I ... direct that the flag of the United States be displayed on all Government buildings on Flag Day, Thursday, June 14, 1951","explanation":"Both use a presidential directive requiring flag display on all Government buildings on the commemorative day."},{"child_excerpt":"I also invite the people of this country to observe the day with ceremonies designed to honor the discoverer of America.","parent_excerpt":"I call upon the people to observe that day with special patriotic ceremonies designed to give expression to our reverence for the flag and the ideals it symbolizes.","explanation":"The child closely follows the parent's public-observance clause, retaining the sequence and distinctive formulation of observing the day through ceremonies designed to honor the occasion's subject."},{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the Congress of the United States, by a joint resolution ... authorized and requested the President to issue a proclamation designating October 12 of each year as Columbus Day","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the Congress, by a joint resolution ... has set aside June 14 of each year as Flag Day","explanation":"Both introduce an annually recurring congressionally established observance before applying the shared flag-display and ceremonial-observance machinery."}]}
